title: release_scratch resolves its paths with its own copies of physical_dir's step, and a // root walks past its refusal
body:
## Problem

The parked note was that `lib/release.steps` repeats clean's physical-directory step and hoisting it is a refactor. The hoist already happened: 0134 moved it into `lib/helpers` as `physical_dir`. What is left is `release_scratch` resolving its two paths with its own copies (`lib/release.steps:196`, `root="$(cd -P "$1" ... && pwd -P)"`, and `:200`, the same for `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}`), and they are not equivalent to `physical_dir`: they keep a leading `//`, pass no `--`, read CDPATH for a relative TMPDIR, and drop a trailing newline from a name. So the check that refuses a scratch directory inside the project can be walked past. Fixed forward in the bundle on hv's word, 2026-10-03.

## Measured at 2ce9411 (0152 v1 on 953d040; cc's evidence pass)

With the libraries sourced and `TMPDIR=<project>/tmp`: `release_scratch "<project>"` is refused, "inside the project", rc 1; `release_scratch "/<project>"` -- the same directory spelled with a leading `//` -- returns rc 0 and creates `<project>/tmp/devbin-release.XXXXXX`. The dispatcher does produce such a root: run from a directory entered as `//...`, doctor prints `devbin doctor -- //Users/...`.

## Fix

`release_scratch` resolves both through `physical_dir`, with the same warnings, so there is one physical-directory step.

## Done when

1. From a directory entered as `//<project>`, with TMPDIR inside the project, `release_scratch` refuses and writes nothing; red at 2ce9411.
2. A scan finds no `$(cd -P ... && pwd -P)` in lib/ outside `physical_dir`, with a floor.

## Resolution

Fixed at 9efbe6be. release_scratch resolves the project root and TMPDIR through physical_dir, the one turn of a directory into its physical path, which spells a leading // as /; its two private copies of `$(cd -P <dir> && pwd -P)` are gone. bin/devbin's bootstrap resolves its own directory before helpers is sourced, so it cannot call physical_dir; it sits outside lib/ and outside the scan, by design.

Against the done-when list:

1. Given `//<project>` with TMPDIR inside the project, `release_scratch` refuses and writes nothing: releasecut.bats's (0162) arm, red on the code beneath this change, which returned 0 and made its scratch inside the project.
2. A scan finds the physical step in lib/ only in physical_dir: contract.bats's (0162) arm counts every `cd -P ... && pwd`, nested substitutions and plain `pwd` included, and requires exactly one hit, in lib/helpers, so a scan that found nothing fails rather than passing; two positive controls hold the copied shape and a nested, plain-pwd one. Red on the code beneath this change, where it found release.steps's two copies.

Evidence. 1 mutant, killed. The arms run green under GNU coreutils, findutils and sed as well as the BSD tools. The full suite on the landing tree: vc's full suite, on main af758c10 (code at 415ce738) with 0163 v3.1 and 0167 git-am'd and cc's 0155, 0160, 0161 and 0162 applied above them, in a fresh clone: 2190 of 2190 ok, 0 not ok, its .errors empty (seal 20261006-0607), 06:07:26Z to 06:55:27Z; 5 skipped, the expected five: two arms that need a runner with no controlling terminal, two require_command arms whose expected outcome is a skip, and a case-folding disk.
